name: Star rule
summary: A new scalar generator, the star, is the inverse of the legless phase-free Z-spider.
description:
To make the stabilizer ZX-calculus complete *with* scalars, Backens adds a new generator with no inputs or outputs, the *star* $\star$, interpreted as $\frac12$. It is defined by the star rule: the star next to the legless phase-free Z-spider (the scalar 2) is the empty diagram. From it one derives inverses for all other non-zero stabilizer scalars.

When scalars are written as numbers, as in the zoo, this rule just says that the legless Z-spider is the number 2: the $\alpha = 0$ case of [legless Z-spiders](../scalar-z-spider/).
unchecked_reason: uses Backens' star generator (the scalar 1/2), which PyZX cannot represent
